name: seq-resumption
description: A torn tail followed by a real restart: the supervisor resumes journaling after recovery and must derive the next `seq` from max(intact seq)+1 — never an in-memory counter, which would have been lost across the crash — and never from the torn record's claimed seq, which cannot be trusted.

events.reason: crash mid-write of the 'spawned' record — the supervisor process (and its in-memory seq counter) dies here

events.displayMessage: Re-appended after restart, correctly resuming at seq 3 (not 4 — the in-memory counter that would have produced 4 was lost with the crashed process)

expected.note: the re-appended record correctly reuses seq 3 (max(intact seq=2)+1), demonstrating the torn record at the old claimed seq 3 is discarded wholesale and never blocks reuse of that seq number
